verdict.rationale: Oneleet is explicitly marketed as a multi-framework compliance platform supporting ISO 27001 alongside SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR (oneleet-docs-29), and includes framework-specific control removal/addition logic (oneleet-docs-15/25/39), audit-ready evidence collection via Fieldwork (oneleet-docs-16/41), and pentest inclusion (oneleet-docs-13/38). However, none of the evidence names ISO 27001-specific artifacts like Annex A control mapping, a Statement of Applicability, or certification-audit specific workflows distinct from generic 'framework' handling. missing for 10: explicit Annex A control set detail, Statement of Applicability generation/support, ISO certification-audit specific artifact examples, independent corroboration of ISO 27001 depth beyond a marketing mention.
